features.label: Wrap around design
features.text: Opens flat and closes around the leg for easy application

features.label: Dual side hinges
features.text: Medial and lateral hinges limit side to side shifting to steady the joint

features.label: Custom compression
features.text: Adjustable straps set pressure above and below the knee

features.label: Open popliteal back
features.text: Reduces bunching behind the knee for sitting comfort

features.label: Fsa and hsa eligible
features.text: Qualifies for tax advantaged health spending accounts

features.label: Pdac approved l1820, l1821
features.text: Knee orthosis, elastic with condylar pads and joints, with or without patellar control, prefabricated, off the shelf

indications: Mild to moderate ligament joint pain
measurement: Measure the circumference around the center of the knee. Keep the leg relaxed and slightly bent while measuring. Measure over bare skin rather than over clothing. One universal size fits 12.5 to 24 in. The wrap design fits either the left or the right leg. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
